blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Students from the University of the Philippines (UP) Tacloban on Tuesday staged campus protests opposing the proposed establishment of a Pax Silica hub in the country, citing concerns over national sovereignty, indigenous peoples’ rights, and the country’s growing economic and security ties with the United States. The students staged a campus-wide walkout, gathering outside the university’s gate to condemn the initiative, coinciding with US President Donald Trump’s visit to the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit in Manila.
